name: Micronaut Core 5.2.5
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Resolve io.* Java packages other than io.micronaut from Python by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13345
* Python: a Python module of a package named like a Java package is the module by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13342
* Status routes of a request no route matches run with the propagated context of the filters by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13357
* Python: keep the Java interface base of classes defined inside functions by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13301
* Python: a Python method overrides one overload of a Java base method by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13332
* Abort a cancelled raw exchange of the Netty client by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13356
* Match a Python override of a generic Java interface method by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13358
* Do not resolve a directory of a jar under a base path as a resource by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13370
### Improvements ⭐
* Python: a Java-created instance of a Python type is the Python object by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13327
### Other Changes 💡
* Keep the context of an asynchronous filter whose stage completes with null by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13359
* Python: a Micronaut annotation read reflectively is copied when reflection is allowed by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13338
* Find a runtime bean definition through an interface looked up before its registration by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13348
* Resolve a relative raw request URI against the Netty client URL by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13362
* Python: a generated asPolyglotValue() never returns null by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13360
* Release the leak tracker of a disk upload whose file was moved by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13367
* Normalize Windows Python bytecode cache paths by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13377
* Report the Python types whose reflection data is left off only when asked by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13374
* Write a file body of a HEAD response for its headers and close it by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13372


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.4...v5.2.5
